- Forward ASCII >> answer
- Forward Unicode → answer
- Backward ASCII << prompt
- Backward Unicode ← prompt
- Both ASCII <> answer
- Both Unicode ↔ answer
- Concept :: definition
- descriptor ;; value
- Disabled >- answer
- Multiline >>>
  - First answer
  - Second answer
- Ordered answer >>1.
  1. First
  2. Second
- Choice >>A)
  - Correct
  - Distractor
- Sentence with ==first cloze== and ==second cloze==
- Cluster parent #cluster
  - Clustered ==card==
